name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the presidential elections in Honduras, the non-recognition of the outcome by the incumbent administration and the attacks on opposition members of the National Assembly
part_text: 1a. Emphasises that free elections require full respect for human rights and fundamental freedoms, independent and impartial electoral authorities, transparency throughout the electoral process, effective oversight and appeal mechanisms, and the absence of intimidation, coercion, violence and foreign interference, to ensure that the will of the people is respected; notes that some of these conditions were not met during the electoral process in Honduras;
